name: dnd-inventory-tracker
description: D&D Inventory Tracker — gestiona los inventarios de tu campaña de Dungeons & Dragons

scripts.setup: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix client run typecheck && npm --prefix server run typecheck
